title: Patient Care Desk Guidance — Immunization Services Course Start, Completion, Cancellation and Stock Substitution
content:
An Immunization Services course moves through its statuses by the doses given on it and, for cancellation, by the patient's own request. The desk applies the following.

**Start.** A course starts, moving to in progress, when its first dose of a multi-dose series is given.

**Completion.** A course completes when the dose recorded as the final dose is given.

**Cancellation.** A course is cancelled only at the patient's own request, which the patient confirms themselves. Cancelling ends any open appointment of the course and keeps every dose already given on record.

**Finishing a series later — no longer in force.** The former statement that a later wish to finish the series opens a new course in which outside and earlier doses count where the vaccination accepts outside records is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis.

**Out of stock.** When the vaccination the patient booked is out of stock, the vaccination listed as its substitute may be given instead, by opening a course of that vaccination; where the listed substitute is none, the appointment is rebooked.

## Status outcomes

| Event on the course | Status afterwards |
|---|---|
| First dose of a multi-dose series given | In progress |
| Dose recorded as the final dose given | Completed |
| Patient's own confirmed request to cancel | Cancelled; open appointment ended; doses given stay on record |

## Hypothetical stock cases

- A hypothetical patient booked for the Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination arrives when high-dose stock is out: its listed substitute, the Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination, may be given by opening a course of the standard-dose vaccination.
- A hypothetical patient booked for the RSV Older Adult Vaccination arrives when it is out of stock: its listed substitute is none, so the appointment is rebooked.

superseded_clauses: a later wish to finish the series opens a new course in which outside and earlier doses count where outside_record_accepted is true
